note: Controlled vocabulary for the UAP Shape Census. Each canonical shape carries the alias terms the extractor matches (whole-word, case-insensitive; internal spaces match flexible whitespace and optional hyphen). This file is meant to GROW — add aliases as real prose reveals them, and bump `version` when you do so the page's methodology panel can show which lexicon produced the data. Order here is the default display order on the page (most-iconic first).

shapes.label: Disc
shapes.disambiguation: Classic 'flying saucer'. Watch for 'disc' meaning a record/hard-disc/brake-disc in non-sighting context — the Phase 3 LLM pass is meant to catch these.

shapes.label: Sphere / Orb
shapes.disambiguation: 'Ball' and 'round' are high-noise terms (ball of yarn, round trip). Keep the snippet so a human/LLM can confirm it describes a craft.

shapes.label: Triangle
shapes.disambiguation: Belgian-wave / Phoenix-Lights morphology. 'V-shaped' overlaps with boomerang — prefer Triangle when a solid body is described, Boomerang/Chevron when an open formation/winged shape is described.

shapes.label: Boomerang / Chevron
shapes.disambiguation: Ufologically distinct from a solid triangle — an open, bent or winged shape. Split out deliberately so the two don't collapse together.

shapes.label: Cylinder / Cigar
shapes.disambiguation: The long-axis craft. Keep separate from Tic-Tac/Pill — a cigar is typically large and elongated; a Tic-Tac is small, white, rounded-end.

shapes.label: Tic-Tac / Pill
shapes.disambiguation: Its own bucket because it became an iconic, time-stamped morphology post-2004 (Nimitz). A subtype of Cylinder conceptually, but tracked separately for the timeline.

shapes.label: Egg / Ovoid
shapes.disambiguation: Includes the teardrop/acorn morphology noted in crash-retrieval testimony (e.g. the Weygandt/Barber 'egg' analogy in the Cartography project).

shapes.label: Cone
shapes.disambiguation: Includes 'spinning top' and 'bell' forms. 'Bell' can collide with the Nazi-Bell trope and with literal bells — keep the snippet.

shapes.label: Diamond
shapes.disambiguation: 'Diamond' also means the gemstone/baseball field — context snippet required.

shapes.label: Cube / Box
shapes.disambiguation: High-noise terms ('square deal', 'box of'). Strongly benefits from the Phase 3 LLM filter.

shapes.label: Other / Unspecified
shapes.disambiguation: Catch-all for 'a craft of no clear shape', shape-shifting reports, and explicitly-unspecified morphology. Not a default dumping ground — only matched on these explicit phrases.
